meta.company: Panco Foods Inc. (DBA Pan's Mushroom Jerky)
meta.thesis: Pan's does not need more stores - it needs more bags sold per store, and Mushroom Mode turns H-E-B shelf space into trial.
meta.variant_angle: Pans A: trial program - H-E-B sell-through

business_problem: Pan's grew from ~750 to 2,500+ stores while revenue fell from $3.15M to a ~$3.0M annualized pace with losses every year: a sell-through (velocity) problem at the shelf, made worse because shoppers file it with declining plant-based meat instead of growing meat snacks.

objectives.text: Drive 6,000 attributed purchases of Pan's at 10 Central Texas H-E-B stores in 45 days (coupon + demo-tracked)
Deliver 4,000 in-store samples and 15,000 digital coupon claims
Reach 3.5M Texas impressions and lift aided awareness among surveyed Central Texas shoppers by 10 points

segments.name: Gen-Z Snack Explorers (14-24)
segments.demographic: 14-24, high school and college students, mixed income, Central Texas
segments.geographic: Austin, Round Rock, Georgetown, San Marcos, Waco (Texas District 5 area)
segments.psychographic: Curious about new flavors, 'better-for-you' leaning but taste-first; skeptical of products that imitate meat
segments.behavioral: Buys savory snacks weekly at H-E-B, c-stores, and campus stores; tries new snacks from creator content and friends
segments.media: TikTok and Instagram Reels daily; YouTube; group chats; low email use

segments.name: Flexitarian H-E-B Parents (30-50)
segments.demographic: 30-50, household income $60K+, parents buying lunchbox and after-school snacks
segments.geographic: Central Texas suburbs served by H-E-B
segments.psychographic: Wants cleaner snacks with no allergens to worry about; open to plant-based but not willing to pay for disappointment
segments.behavioral: Weekly H-E-B shopper; uses the H-E-B app and digital coupons; buys meat snacks for kids
segments.media: Facebook, Instagram, H-E-B app, email newsletters

methods.recruitment: SEC filing, GFI/SPINS, Circana via trade press, company pages

programs.name: Mushroom Mode Demo Days
programs.mechanic: 20 weekend demo shifts across 10 Central Texas H-E-B stores (Austin, Round Rock, Georgetown, San Marcos, Waco). Sample cups beside the jerky set, QR code to the 'buy 2 save $3' coupon. Target 200 samples per shift.

programs.name: The Aisle Switch
programs.mechanic: Proposed to H-E-B: a clip strip of Pan's inside the meat-snack set plus a shelf talker 'Love jerky? Switch to Mushroom Mode' and a digital 'buy 2 save $3' coupon in the H-E-B app.

programs.name: Mushroom Mode Taste-Off
programs.mechanic: 4 Texas food creators run blind taste-offs: Pan's vs. their favorite beef jerky. Viewers duet with #MushroomMode; every video carries the coupon link and #ad disclosure.

programs.name: Founder's Table
programs.mechanic: Michael Pan's Shark Tank-to-H-E-B story told in 3 short videos and 3 emails/SMS to the existing list, each ending with the Texas store finder and coupon.

lines.item: Paid social (TikTok, Meta) geo-targeted to Central Texas

kpis.kpi: Attributed purchases (coupon redemptions + demo-day sales lift)
kpis.baseline: Week-0 store sell-through from Pan's/H-E-B data
kpis.tool: H-E-B digital coupon report + unique QR codes + store sales data

kpis.kpi: Units per store per week at the 10 test stores vs. 10 control stores
Samples handed out and coupon claims

assumptions.text: Brand revenue per purchase ~$8.00: 2 bags at ~$4.00 wholesale (~50% of $7.99-8.99 shelf price); confirm with company
Gross margin ~42%: average of FY22 (40%), FY23 (30%), and YTD FY24 (57%) from SEC filing figures
H-E-B store-level baseline velocity unknown; measured week 0 via shelf audit + company sell-through data
Paid social: ~$2.30 CPM; 1.5% CTR on coupon creative; 12% coupon-claim-to-purchase (validate week 1)
Pan's and H-E-B would approve in-store demos and a digital coupon (proposed, not confirmed)
Texas food micro-creators (10K-80K followers): ~$750 per video incl. product
In-store demo shift ~$150 (4-hr demo staff via sampling agency, product included)
Coupon cost: $1.50 brand-funded discount on first 1,000 redemptions; beyond that absorbed in margin
Production (shelf talkers, sample cups, design) ~$800 via local print shop quotes
Email/SMS + landing page tools ~$300 for the campaign window
Event costs: campus venue comped by student orgs; prizes and stage materials ~$1,500

slides.title: Campaign Overview
bullets: Thesis: Pan's does not need more stores - it needs more bags sold per store [S1].
Problem: Pan's grew from ~750 to 2,500+ stores, yet revenue fell from $3.15M (FY22) and the company loses money every year [S1][S2][S4].
Business opportunity: meat snacks grew 11.3% to $6.4B while plant-based meat fell 10% - Pan's is filed in the wrong mental aisle [S6][S7].
Solution: 'Switch to Mushroom Mode' moves Pan's into the jerky shopper's decision at 10 Central Texas H-E-B stores [O1].
45-day goal: 6,000 attributed purchases and +25% units per store vs. control stores [O1].

visual.desc: Four boxes: Problem / Business opportunity / Solution / 45-day goal

slides.notes: Open with the paradox: Pan's went from about 750 stores to 2,500, yet revenue fell. The problem is not distribution - it is what happens at the shelf.

slides.title: The Product
bullets: Shiitake mushroom jerky from a decades-old Pan family recipe found in Malaysia; chewy, savory, umami [S2].
Vegan, gluten-free, Kosher, no allergens to declare; the brand says it 'isn't trying to completely imitate beef' [S5].
Shelf price $7.99-$8.99 per 2.2 oz bag; cost to make about $1.67 per bag at launch [S3].
Four core flavors; sold online, on Amazon, and in grocery including H-E-B in Texas [S2][S10].

visual.desc: Flat-lay of four flavor bags with a torn-open bag showing the jerky texture

slides.notes: Stress the brand's own words: it is not trying to be beef. That line becomes our whole positioning.

slides.title: The Company & Its Position
bullets: Founded by engineer Michael Pan; launched 2018; Mark Cuban invested $300K for 18% on Shark Tank in 2020 [S3][S4].
Revenue $3.15M (FY22) -> $2.88M (FY23) -> $2.78M (11 months FY24); net loss every year [S1].
Store count rose from about 750 to 2,500+ while revenue fell - fewer bags sold per store [S1][S2][S4].
Category tailwind: meat snacks +11.3% to $6.4B; headwind: plant-based meat -10% [S6][S7].

visual.desc: Line chart: revenue FY22-FY24 falling vs. bar chart of store count rising; category map with meat snacks up and plant-based meat down

slides.notes: This is our most important slide for credibility: every number comes from the company's own SEC filing.

slides.title: Campaign Objectives
bullets: O1 (primary, conversion): 6,000 attributed purchases at 10 Central Texas H-E-B stores [O1].
O2 (consideration): 4,000 in-store samples and 15,000 digital coupon claims [O2].
O3 (awareness): 3.5M Texas impressions and +10 points aided awareness [O3].
Success test: test stores beat 10 matched control stores on units per store per week [O1].

visual.desc: O1-O3 with funnel stage, metric, target, and test-vs-control design

slides.notes: One primary objective - bags sold - measured against control stores, so the client sees lift, not noise.

slides.title: Target Market
bullets: P1 Gen-Z Snack Explorers, 14-24: weekly snack buyers in Central Texas who try snacks from TikTok and friends; skeptical of fake meat [S8][S11].
P2 Flexitarian H-E-B Parents, 30-50: weekly H-E-B shoppers using app coupons; want snacks with no allergens to worry about [S5][S9].
Both share one need: a savory snack that is honest about what it is - the reason Pan's says it is not imitating beef [S5].
Market: 6 in 10 US households already buy plant-based foods [S11].

visual.desc: Two persona cards (P1, P2) with photo, demographics, psychographics, and media habits

slides.notes: Primary research (survey and interviews) will validate and refine both personas before submission.

slides.title: Research Method & Results
bullets: Secondary (complete): SEC filing, GFI/SPINS, Circana via trade press, company pages - 11 sources [S1][S6][S7][S8].
Key results: revenue down while stores up [S1][S2]; meat snacks +11.3% [S7]; plant-based meat -10% [S6]; jerky flat while meat sticks surge [S8].
Primary (in field): 10-question survey of Central Texas snack buyers, 3-5 shopper interviews with taste test, and an H-E-B shelf audit at 3 stores.
Influences: protein snacking boom (social), plant-based fatigue (cultural), food inflation (economic), app coupons (technological) [S6][S7][S9].

visual.desc: Methods table (4 methods, n, dates, status) + bar chart of category growth: meat snacks +11.3%, plant-based meat -10%

slides.notes: Name the methods and sample sizes out loud. When the survey closes, the bar chart gets our own results.

slides.title: Insights -> Campaign Decisions
bullets: Finding: store count up, revenue down [S1][S2] -> therefore we fund trial at the shelf (Demo Days), not more distribution.
Finding: meat snacks +11.3%, plant-based meat -10% [S6][S7] -> therefore Pan's is placed and messaged next to jerky, not with fake meat (Aisle Switch).
Finding: brand says it is not imitating beef [S5] -> therefore creators run honest taste-offs instead of 'tastes just like beef' claims.
Finding: losses every year [S1] -> therefore every dollar is trackable (coupons, QR, test vs. control).

visual.desc: Four finding -> therefore rows with source tags

slides.notes: Each campaign decision traces to evidence. When survey results arrive, we add them as R1-R3 and cite them on the program slides.

slides.title: Campaign Strategy
bullets: Big idea: Mushroom Mode - not fake meat, a savory snack you switch into. Message: 'Love jerky? Switch to Mushroom Mode.'
Positioning: for Texas snackers who want something savory and honest, Pan's is the jerky made from shiitake that does not pretend to be beef [S5].
IMC mix: Paid (geo social) + Earned (Shark Tank founder story) + Shared (#MushroomMode duets) + Owned (email/SMS, shelf talkers).
Push-pull: H-E-B gets a measurable velocity test (push); shoppers get samples and a coupon (pull) [O1][O2].

visual.desc: Key visual: split frame - beef jerky aisle on left, Pan's bag glowing on right, 'Switch to Mushroom Mode' lockup

slides.notes: Point to the positioning statement. A competitor that imitates meat cannot say this line - that is what makes it ownable.

slides.title: 45-Day Schedule
bullets: Mushroom Mode W1-2 (Jan 5-18): Aisle Switch talkers and coupon live (P2, retail, O1/O2, trade lead); Demo Days start (P2, sampling, O1/O2, field lead); Founder's Table email 1 (P1, O3).
W3-5 (Jan 19-Feb 8): Taste-Off creator videos (P1, TikTok/IG, O1/O3, social lead); weekend demos continue; retargeting to coupon viewers.
W6-7 (Feb 9-18): final demo weekends, last-chance coupon push, results read vs. control stores (O1).

visual.desc: Gantt: 7 weeks x programs (Aisle Switch, Demo Days, Taste-Off, Founder's Table) with segment and owner labels

slides.notes: 45 days exactly. January is deliberate: New Year snack resets put better-for-you snacks top of mind.

slides.title: Program 1: Mushroom Mode Demo Days
bullets: Mushroom Mode in person: 20 weekend demo shifts at 10 Central Texas H-E-B stores [O1][O2].
Mechanic: sample cups at the jerky set; QR code to 'buy 2 save $3'; target 200 samples per shift = 4,000 total [A7].
Why: shoppers do not buy what they cannot imagine tasting - sampling converts curiosity at the shelf.
Measured: QR scans per store and sales lift vs. matched control stores [O1].

visual.desc: Demo table mockup: orange tablecloth, 'Switch to Mushroom Mode' banner, sample cups, QR sign

slides.notes: Interactive moment: hand the judge the printed shelf talker and sample-cup sleeve.

slides.title: Program 2: The Aisle Switch
bullets: Mushroom Mode on the shelf: proposed clip strip of Pan's inside the H-E-B meat-snack set [O1].
Shelf talker: 'Love jerky? Switch to Mushroom Mode. Scan for $3 off 2 bags.' [A8]
Digital: 'buy 2 save $3' coupon in the H-E-B app, funded on the first 1,000 redemptions [A8][O2].
Why: meat snacks are growing 11.3% - Pan's should be where those shoppers already stand [S7].

visual.desc: Shelf mockup: Pan's clip strip hanging between Jack Link's and Chomps, orange shelf talker with QR

slides.notes: This is a proposal to H-E-B's buyer, framed as a 6-week velocity test with control stores.

slides.title: Program 3: Taste-Off + Founder's Table
bullets: Mushroom Mode online: 4 Texas food creators run blind Pan's vs. beef jerky taste-offs; fans duet with #MushroomMode [O1][O3].
Every video: coupon link, Texas store finder, #ad disclosure (FTC).
Founder's Table: Michael Pan tells the Malaysia recipe-to-Shark Tank story in 3 videos and 3 emails/SMS [S2][S3].
Named decision-maker: Mark Cuban's investment is the credibility hook for the H-E-B pitch [S4].

visual.desc: TikTok phone mockup: split-screen taste-off with score cards; email mockup from Michael Pan

slides.notes: Honest taste-offs only work because Pan's does not claim to be beef - competitors that do cannot run this.

slides.title: Creative Samples
bullets: Shelf talker: 'Love jerky? Switch to Mushroom Mode. Scan: $3 off 2 bags.' [O1]
TikTok caption: 'Blind taste-off: beef jerky vs. mushroom jerky. I did not expect this. #MushroomMode #ad' [O3]
SMS (opted-in): 'Pan's: Mushroom Mode is at your H-E-B. Save $3 on 2 bags this week: [link]. Reply STOP to opt out.' [O1]
Email subject/preview: 'I put my family recipe on Shark Tank. Now it's at H-E-B.' / 'Save $3 - Michael' [O1]

visual.desc: Phone mockups (SMS, TikTok, email) plus printed shelf talker

slides.title: Proposed Budget & Financial Viability
bullets: Total $15,000: paid social $6,000 [A4]; creators 4 x $750 = $3,000 [A6]; demos 20 x $150 = $3,000 [A7]; coupon $1,500 [A8]; production $800 [A9]; tools $300 [A10]; contingency $400 [A11].
Funnel: 3.5M impressions x 1.5% CTR x 12% purchase = 6,300 purchases x $8 brand revenue = $50.4K [A1][A4].
Gross profit at 42% = $21.2K; profit ROI 41%; ROAS 5.6x on $9K ad spend [A2].
Break-even 4,464 purchases. Conservative case (50%) 3,150 loses $4.4K in-window - offset by repeat buyers and keeping shelf space [O1].

visual.desc: Itemized budget table + funnel math + base vs. conservative case

slides.notes: Be honest about the conservative case: a velocity test can lose a little in-window but protects 2,500 stores of distribution.

slides.title: Impact & Measurement
bullets: O1: attributed purchases via H-E-B coupon report + unique QR codes; target 6,000; weekly [O1].
O1: units per store per week, 10 test vs. 10 control stores; target +25% [O1].
O2: samples and coupon claims; target 4,000 and 15,000; per shift and weekly [O2].
O3: 3.5M impressions (Ads Manager) and +10 pts aided awareness (pre/post survey) [O3].
Trigger: if QR scans per shift fall under 20 by week 3, move demos to the top 5 stores; if creator CTR is under 1%, shift spend to Meta [A4].

visual.desc: KPI table: objective -> KPI -> baseline -> target -> tool -> cadence

slides.notes: Test vs. control is what a CPG buyer wants: proof the lift came from the campaign.

slides.title: Why It Matters
bullets: Thesis: Pan's does not need more stores - it needs more bags sold per store. Mushroom Mode turns H-E-B shelf space into trial [O1].
Projected: 6,300 purchases and $50.4K brand revenue on $15K, plus a test-vs-control result Pan's can take to every retailer [A1][O1].
Mission: a family recipe from Malaysia, honest about what it is - kept on Texas shelves because Texans tried it [S2][S5].
Next: if test stores beat control by 25%, roll Mushroom Mode to more H-E-B stores [O1].
